figures.finding: A minor of eight to eighteen has limited capacity: his legal acts are done by his legal representative (the guardian) or with that representative's consent or ratification, save those purely to his benefit or suited to his age and intelligence; a minor of sixteen or more whose main living comes from his own labour income is treated as fully capable; the guardian may dispose of the ward's property only in the ward's interest. No share of earnings is set aside by law. The rule is general, so it reaches a contract to write or direct as well as to act.

value.binding: the legal representative's act, consent or ratification (Civil Code art. 19)
value.fullCapacityFrom16: if living mainly on own labour income (art. 18)

sources.said: 第十七条 十八周岁以上的自然人为成年人。不满十八周岁的自然人为未成年人。 第十八条 成年人为完全民事行为能力人，可以独立实施民事法律行为。 十六周岁以上的未成年人，以自己的劳动收入为主要生活来源的，视为完全民事行为能力人。 第十九条 八周岁以上的未成年人为限制民事行为能力人，实施民事法律行为由其法定代理人代理或者经其法定代理人同意、追认；但是，可以独立实施纯获利益的民事法律行为或者与其年龄、智力相适应的民事法律行为。 第二十条 不满八周岁的未成年人为无民事行为能力人，由其法定代理人代理实施民事法律行为。 ... 监护人除为维护被监护人利益外，不得处分被监护人的财产。

figures.finding: No employer may recruit anyone under sixteen, but arts and sports units may, with the consent of the minor's parents or other guardian, recruit professional performers (专业文艺工作者) and athletes under sixteen; the unit must protect the child's physical and mental health and his right to compulsory schooling; the detailed measures are set by the State Council's labour department with the culture and sports departments (not read, so no hours or times are held). Under sixteen no one may run an individual business. The exception names professional arts workers, which reads as performers; a child writer or director recruited by such a unit would fall under it too (reading).

value.employerMust: an arts or sports unit (文艺、体育单位)

figures.applies: Provisions on the Prohibition of Using Child Labour (State Council Order No. 364, in force 1 December 2002), arts. 2, 13.

sources.said: 第二条 国家机关、社会团体、企业事业单位、民办非企业单位或者个体工商户 (以下统称用人单位)均不得招用不满16周岁的未成年人(招用不满16周岁的未成年人,以下统称使用童工)。 ... 禁止不满 16周岁的未成年人开业从事个体经营活动。 ... 第十三条 文艺、体育单位经未成年人的父母或者其他监护人同意，可以招用不满 16周岁的专业文艺工作者、运动员。用人单位应当保障被招用的不满16周岁的未成年人的身心健康，保障其接受义务教育的权利。文艺、体育单位招用不满16周岁的专业文艺工作者、运动员的办法，由国务院劳动保障行政部门会同国务院文化、体育行政部门制定。

figures.finding: A person without civil capacity or with only limited capacity may not be a company's director, supervisor or senior manager, so the producer's vehicle is directed from eighteen, or from sixteen by a minor who lives mainly on his own labour income; no one under sixteen may run an individual business.

value.directorFrom16If: living mainly on own labour income (Civil Code art. 18)

figures.applies: Company Law (2023) art. 178; Civil Code art. 18; Order No. 364 art. 2.
